title: Scaling of multicopy constructive interference of Gaussian states
summary: Quantum technology advances crucially depend on the scaling up of essential quantum resources. Their ideal multiplexing offers more significant gains in applications; however, the scaling of the nonidentical, fragile and varying resources is neither theoretically nor experimentally known. For bosonic systems, multimode interference is an essential tool already widely exploited to develop quantum technology.
